name: crystallography
rules: A model and its HKL data must use the same indexing basis.
Keep signed measured intensities; distinguish them from constrained or structure-assisted estimates.
A lower R1 is descriptive until effective data, symmetry, weights and model complexity are comparable.
Inspect original artifacts and difference density before proposing atom, occupancy or disorder changes.
Never claim a structure is accepted solely because a process exited zero.
